arguments.explanation: All four FMB-board parts (u_brown, u_orange, line_green, inverted_u_yellow) were seated at their placement frames within their registry position tolerances, with grasps confirmed by force-threshold contact at the expected width band each time, and no clamp-effort limit was ever approached (max observed ~40N against limits of 100-250N). The interleaved hex_red job failed: after the descend/release/retreat sequence at hex_red_hole, hex_red's measured pose came out ~2.1m from the hole and below the bench, meaning the insertion did not seat the part -- it left the workspace and could not be recovered within this run (recorded as observation obs-001-0f0b56b8 and verdict on place_hex_red). Two borderline in-hand-slip monitor fires occurred (hex_red during its pick/lift at 21.8mm vs 20mm tolerance, and line_green while held at 20.0mm vs 20mm tolerance); both are reported as non-conformant against the stated tolerance even though line_green's own seating was still within its placement tolerance and hex_red's slip is consistent with -- and may be the proximate cause of -- its failed insertion. No bystander (u_green, inverted_u_brown, hex_blue, base2) or base1 disturbance monitor ever fired, and the workspace camera showed no unlisted object, person, or other unexpected event for the whole run. The hex_red departure stands uncorrected at run end, so the run is non_conformant regardless of the other four parts' successful, verified seating.
